limitations: Gazetteer record only: name, representative point and capital status from Natural Earth. It carries no population, climate, housing or school facts; those belong to Agents 01–04 records. The point is Natural Earth's representative location at 1:10 million scale, not a surveyed city centre or a Statistics Canada boundary centroid; expect offsets of up to a few kilometres. Selected because Natural Earth lists it as a national or provincial/territorial capital or gives it pop_max >= 100000; Natural Earth population figures have no stated census vintage and are not reproduced here. The English name is Natural Earth's `name` field; official French names are not yet recorded (name_fr null).
